entity_row.identity: Object name only; 1–2 lines; fixed semantic role
entity_row.quantity: Independent value+unit; trailing alignment; tabular figures
entity_row.status: One badge; optional; not concatenated with title
entity_row.outcome: Decision-critical benefit or effect; prominent before cost
entity_row.cost: All consumed resources and total amount; independent group
entity_row.action: Explicit enum; never inferred from placement

visual_anchor.icons: reuse approved original SVG and content IDs

checks.pass_criteria: 0 titles contain quantity, price, owned/needed ratio, source/state label or action text; legitimate object numbers such as Stove 1 are allowed

checks.rule: Quantity has a dedicated right-aligned value/unit slot
checks.pass_criteria: 100% counts, limits, balance deltas, timers are separate from title; no unexplained numerator/denominator

checks.rule: User can identify outcome before costs and commit
checks.pass_criteria: Exactly one prominent outcome group shows item/effect/quantity; no unique core benefit appears only in footnotes

checks.rule: Costs, recipient and consequences remain visible before commitment
checks.pass_criteria: 100% consumed coin/Energy/material/ticket quantities, actual gain, recipient and destructive/lock duration shown before submission

checks.rule: Remove rule repetition from primary reading order
checks.pass_criteria: No duplicate same fact in header/body/footer; general fulfilled conditions moved to details unless decision-critical

checks.rule: Every action declares one semantic type
checks.pass_criteria: 100% actions classified commit/navigate/dismiss/destructive/selection/worldAction; no implicit first-array-item style

checks.rule: Information navigation uses a chevron row/link treatment
checks.pass_criteria: 0 pure-navigation actions use filled commit component; destination name explicit
At most 1 primary commit per focused decision; inline Equip/row item choices documented exceptions

checks.rule: Cancel destination and consequences are explicit
checks.pass_criteria: Cancel/dismiss never submits; destructive confirmation carries target and refund/loss summary; no guide-like ambiguous cancel control

checks.rule: Remove fake storyboard progression from device viewport
checks.pass_criteria: 0 Tap Stove, Tap pot, After collecting continue, View progress after interaction, Return after making room pseudo-actions; review navigation outside device
Stove/pot/heat action targets match visible control; no duplicate bottom CTA for same scene action

checks.rule: Only facts and navigation, never preselected consumption
checks.pass_criteria: Eat/Cook/Tea/Rest entries navigate to relevant source; 0 predicted Eat +40 or direct Rest executions from Energy Card
Locked row opens four-facts gate card; reason, progress, outcome visible; no dead gray-only locked row
Each family includes relevant default, selected, loading, empty, blocked, completed, failure states; impossible combinations prevented

checks.rule: Capacity failure preserves and locates items
checks.pass_criteria: Full states identify exact remaining location; zero fabricated loss, overwrite, cash conversion or cross-container bypass
Pending disables duplicate submit; completed is feedback/status; retry does not imply repeated charge/reward

checks.rule: Single short message with recovery when useful
checks.pass_criteria: One toast at a time, duplicate event deduplicated, icon + text; no hidden mandatory costs or permanent rules only in toast
Body >=14 px; primary heading >=20 px; supporting text >=12 px; any compact HUD exception listed and tested on device, never for unique critical info
At +30% label length and two-line object name: no overlap/crop, no font-size reduction below token, quantity remains aligned

checks.verification: token contrast calculation + final screenshot spot check
checks.pass_criteria: All enabled text/CTA labels >=4.5:1 against worst background/gradient endpoint

checks.rule: Critical icon/boundary contrast >=3:1 and non-color cue
checks.pass_criteria: Selected/short/locked/error states carry shape/icon/text; color alone never communicates result
100% close/icon/link/action hit regions >=44x44; small visual icon may sit within expanded transparent region
Shared spacing tokens; identity/outcome/cost/action in order; no entire scene shrink to preserve tiny panel
Cream drawer, five-column Bag, six-slot Gear, Quick Bar, Nunito and icon palette preserved; semantic improvements documented
Two-row HUD/location map entry; five consumables + Bag; 176 source-unit action circle; facility rooms do not gain Cook/Shop world button

checks.rule: Every source card has a migration mapping
checks.pass_criteria: 288/288 listed with source and target IDs/files, status, family and relevant state; no silent omissions or duplicate active authority

checks.rule: Editable reconstruction, not screenshot tracing overlay
checks.pass_criteria: Player UI labels/buttons/panels/grids are editable instances; only scene/art bitmaps allowed; original screenshots kept as comparison references
EntityRow has Identity/Quantity/Status/Outcome/Action; controls instantiated; no detached local copies for routine text/quantity changes
Change component label/type spacing in master, verify at least 3 families, restore; no stale local overrides

checks.rule: Navigation and commitment reflect product behavior
checks.pass_criteria: No one-click condition/time fast-forward in player UI; all navigation destinations exist; back returns to source
Costs equal balance/inventory changes, canceled action no charge, refund once, capacity counts consistent

checks.rule: Do not convert open decisions into approved behavior
checks.pass_criteria: Every unresolved rule labeled outside player viewport and linked to OPEN-ITEMS; no invented numeric recipe/unlock/refund
Every family/state has final screenshot and inspected status; audit before-captures never counted as final QA
Static design checks separated from keyboard/screen-reader/touch/network/runtime checks; no unsupported compliance claim
